# Run manifest (generated by `experiments/run_manifest.py`)

Every run directory in `experiments/r2_runs`. Items are the stored job results; ok counts the items whose solve succeeded; repairs are items replaced under a recorded solver rule (`experiments/p1d_repair.py`), with the replaced attempts kept in the listed directories. The `v4_*` runs are the checkpoint-and-resume verification runs of `tests/test_resume.py` (kill, relaunch, bit-identity), partial by design.
